import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    a1 = int(next(it))
    a2 = int(next(it))
    a3 = int(next(it))
    b1 = int(next(it))
    b2 = int(next(it))
    b3 = int(next(it))
    max_val = min(a1, b2) + min(a2, b3) + min(a3, b1)

    def compute_ans(order):
        a = [a1, a2, a3]
        b = [b1, b2, b3]
        for i in range(3):
            x = order[i]
            y = order[(i+1) % 3]
            if b[x] > a[y]:
                b[x] -= a[y]
                a[y] = 0
                z = order[(i+2) % 3]
                if b[x] > a[z]:
                    b[x] -= a[z]
                    a[z] = 0
                else:
                    a[z] -= b[x]
                    b[x] = 0
            else:
                a[y] -= b[x]
                b[x] = 0
        return a[0] + a[1] + a[2]

    orders = [
        [1, 2, 0],
        [1, 0, 2],
        [2, 1, 0],
        [2, 0, 1],
        [0, 2, 1],
        [0, 1, 2]
    ]
    min_val = min(compute_ans(order) for order in orders)
    sys.stdout.write(f"{min_val} {max_val}\n")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
